scope: development-only frozen training partition; rows without a local PDF excluded

guardrails.labels: R3 dereferenced only after fixed-training and local-PDF membership gates
allowed_runtime_feature_sources: original-paper text from page cache for a verified local PDF
optional frozen positive ROCKMAG expert-KB runtime original-text patterns
identifier_feature_exclusion: REFNO used only for alignment, scope aggregation, and GroupKFold
RESULTNO used only to align a permitted training label

oracle_diagnostics.warning: diagnostic label-consistency ceilings only; not deployable strategies and not counted as model results

target_local_predefined_fusion.rule: predefined local-text and three-model expert-count fusion

target_local_canonical_pool.rule: average only rows sharing REFNO and canonical ROCKNAME target

single_target_article_25.rule: single-target papers blend article probability at weight 0.25; multi-target rows remain target-local

single_target_article_50.rule: single-target papers blend article probability at weight 0.50; multi-target rows remain target-local

single_target_article_75.rule: single-target papers blend article probability at weight 0.75; multi-target rows remain target-local

single_target_article_100.rule: single-target papers blend article probability at weight 1.00; multi-target rows remain target-local

multi_shared_article_25.rule: multi-target rows with shared original-text evidence blend article probability at weight 0.25

multi_shared_article_50.rule: multi-target rows with shared original-text evidence blend article probability at weight 0.50

multi_shared_article_75.rule: multi-target rows with shared original-text evidence blend article probability at weight 0.75

multi_shared_article_100.rule: multi-target rows with shared original-text evidence blend article probability at weight 1.00

multi_all_article_25.rule: ablation: every multi-target row blends article probability at weight 0.25

multi_all_article_50.rule: ablation: every multi-target row blends article probability at weight 0.50

multi_all_article_75.rule: ablation: every multi-target row blends article probability at weight 0.75

multi_all_article_100.rule: ablation: every multi-target row blends article probability at weight 1.00

scope_gated_article_25.rule: single-target or shared-evidence multi-target rows blend article probability at weight 0.25

scope_gated_article_50.rule: single-target or shared-evidence multi-target rows blend article probability at weight 0.50

scope_gated_article_75.rule: single-target or shared-evidence multi-target rows blend article probability at weight 0.75

scope_gated_article_100.rule: single-target or shared-evidence multi-target rows blend article probability at weight 1.00

paper_mean_target_local.rule: mean target-local probability within REFNO, propagated to all rows

paper_majority_vote_target_local.rule: hard majority/mean-threshold target-local decision within REFNO

paper_text_majority_predefined_fusion.rule: predefined article knowledge-text and three-model expert-count majority fusion

target_plus_paper_mean_25.rule: canonical target probability blended with within-paper target mean at weight 0.25

target_plus_paper_mean_50.rule: canonical target probability blended with within-paper target mean at weight 0.50

target_plus_paper_mean_75.rule: canonical target probability blended with within-paper target mean at weight 0.75

nested_threshold.selection_boundary: each outer test fold threshold selected only from 4-fold REFNO-grouped inner OOF predictions over the outer training papers

posthoc_full_threshold.warning: full threshold selected post-hoc on all grouped-OOF training predictions; diagnostic upper bound only

selection.rule: maximum coverage subject to known accuracy >=0.90 and both class F1 >=0.50
selection.warning: threshold selected on the same grouped-OOF training predictions; external REFNO validation is required
